title: Puff and the Softest Pillow
summary: A little bear cannot sleep on a flat pillow, so Puff the cloud shares a few puffs of fluff.
tagged: [happy][gesture:wave] Hi there, I am Puff, the fluffiest cloud in the whole sky. [neutral] My favourite thing to do is to float slowly over sleepy towns and hum quiet lullabies. [curious][gesture:peek] One evening I peeked through a small window and saw a little bear who could not fall asleep. [listening] The bear sighed that its pillow had lost all of its softness. [thinking][gesture:think] I thought for a moment, because a cloud knows quite a lot about softness. [excited][gesture:bounce] Then I had an idea and shook myself gently, just like a dog after a swim! [surprised] Tiny puffs of cloud fluff drifted down through the window like warm snow. [happy] The little bear gathered them into the pillow, and it became as soft as a sunset. [love] The bear smiled, hugged the pillow and whispered thank you to the sky. [shy][gesture:shy] I blushed a little pink, the way clouds do when the sun says goodnight. [pause:0.8][sleepy][gesture:yawn] Now the stars are coming out, and even I feel a yawn floating up inside me. [sleepy][gesture:sleep] Good night, little one, I will drift right outside your window until morning.
